atoms.text: Now Maxie is going to show you around some towns.

instruction.text: Select the three images of towns.

feedback.finish: Correct! Towns are usually smaller than cities and have fewer people, so there aren’t many tall buildings.
feedback.wrong: This is the city of Dubai in the United Arab Emirates.

instruction.text: Maxie wants to show you some towns in the UK. This is Reading in England. Select the statue to learn more.
instruction.sound: Maxie wants to show you some towns in the UK. This is Redding in England. Select the statue to learn more.

feedback.end: You can see the town hall of Reading here. Towns in the UK usually all have one, as it’s where the town council does their work for the people.

instruction.text: This is Ayr in Scotland. Select one of the bridges to learn more.

feedback.end: You can find similar things in towns as in cities, such as places to work and have fun at. But, because towns are smaller, there are fewer of these places.

instruction.text: Now we’re in Hallstatt, Austria. Select the lake to learn more.
instruction.sound: Now we’re in Halshtat, Austria. Select the lake to learn more.

end.text: Even though Halstatt is in the middle of the mountains, it still has lots of shops, restaurants and houses.
end.sound: Even though Halshtat is in the middle of the mountains, it still has lots of shops, restaurants and houses..

instruction.text: Maxie wants to know what you will normally find in towns. Select the three correct answers.

feedback.correct2: Public transport in towns is usually focused on getting people to other towns or cities. Most towns are small enough that you can easily cycle or walk to most places.
feedback.correct3: Towns normally have a high street, which is where you find most shops.

instruction.text: Let’s do some fieldwork! Maxie wants to find out what there is in the town of Marlow in England. Select the correct place on the image.

feedback.finish: Great! You can use aerial photographs to see what different types of buildings and structures there are in an area.

instruction.text: What tools are useful when doing fieldwork? Select the three correct answers.

feedback.correct1: You should always bring paper and a pencil so you can note down the things you see around town.
feedback.correct2: A compass shows which direction you’re going, so it’ll help you find your way around.
feedback.correct3: You'll need a map to help you get around town and find certain places you want to visit.
